description: Fork of exp115 trading nap for tph: nap 8 -> 6 (table_dim 256 -> 64, 4x smaller per-table), tph multiplied by 4 (qk/v 384 -> 1536, out 2048 -> 8192). Per-layer LUT weights unchanged (qk/v: 6*1536*64*8=4.72M, out: 1*8192*64*8=4.19M). Effects: 4x more tables/output (qk/v 24 expected vs 6, out 21 vs 5), 3x higher pair coverage (qk/v 12.5% vs 4.2%, out 66.8% vs 22.3%). Other settings (E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, MHLut+smooth+na=1, classic skip, linear unembedder, n_sparse=8) match exp115.
